And: 1 Union of India - by its Secretary Dept. of Health & Family Welfare New Delhi 2 Director Bureau of Indian Standards Bangalore Branch, Peenya Industrial Area I Stage, Bangalore 3 State of Karnataka - by its Secretary Dept. of Food & Civil Supplies M S Building, Vidhana Veedhi Bangalore 1 2 4 Joint Director District Industrial Center Gulbarga 5 Food Safety Officer Gulbarga Mahanagar Palike North Smt. Meena W/O Shankerlal Jat vs Union Of India Represented By Its ... on 19 April, 2013 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107810530/ 1 O/o District Surveillance Officer Old Hospital Road, Gulbarga 6 Deputy Commissioner Mini Vidhana Soudha, Gulbarga 7 Commissioner Gulbarga City Corporation Gulbarga Respondents ( By Sri Manavendra Reddy, Ga) The Appeal is filed under S.4 of the High Court Act praying to [LEAKAGE_MASK] the order dated 10.4.2013 in Wp 100789/2013 and quash the notice dated 23.1.2013 issued by the 5th respondent, etc. The Appeal coming on for Orders this day, Huluvadi G Ramesh J., delivered the following:- Judgment
texts.facts: Appeal is against the dismissal of the writ petition filed by the petitioner seeking to quash the order at annexure H dated 23.1.2013. According to the counsel for the appellant, by a common order, learned Single Judge of the Principal Bench had directed the respondent authorities to conduct inspection within three months from the date of order with regard to maintaining standard in supply of packaged water in the Unit and whether they have ISI mark or not. In this regard, the grievance of the appellant is that, despite submission of the application as per the direction of the learned Single Judge of the Principal Bench, respondent authorities have not visited the plant as to whether there is compliance or not and more than three months have lapsed. Rather, they have proceeded to issue a notice as per annexure H dated 21.3.2013 demanding the appellant to close down the unit. The grievance of the appellant is, when the application already filed as per the direction of this Court was pending consideration, without processing or complying with the order to comply with the minimum standard as required (ISI specification), unilaterally notice has been issued and also the matter is taken up before the learned Single Judge and the order passed therein so far is not released. Meanwhile, petitioner/appellant is before this Court seeking to quash the notice dated 21.3.2013. At the outset, it was for the respondent authorities to have considered the application filed by the appellant as per the general direction issued by the learned Single Judge of the Principal Bench to inspect the Unit with regard to supply of packaged water as per ISI specification. Without compliance, rather they proceed to initiate action to close down the Unit of which the appellant being aggrieved moved WP 10789/2013, and learned Single Judge has dismissed the writ petition Smt. Meena W/O Shankerlal Jat vs Union Of India Represented By Its ... on 19 April, 2013 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107810530/ 2 itself in stead of quashing the notification. The respondent authorities have proceeded to issue notice hurriedly without compliance of the earlier direction issued by the learned Single Judge of the Principal Bench.
